coverage.fingerprint_note: Route type/short name and full ordered stop coordinates rounded6 decimals plus arrival/departure/pickup; observable duplicate audit, not proof of all semantic equivalence.

note: Actual two-cell source/network probe; not integrated transport score or all-city coverage. Half-open08:00..09:00; boarding pickup0/empty only; one feed+service date+trip counted once across accessible platforms. Manual stop entrance/barrier QA and score promotion remain pending.
prefilter: EPSG2180 straight-line <=850m is only conservative candidate rejection; eligibility requires real native walking <=600s at4.8km/h. No distance-circle reachability layer.
